questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Salesforce and/or Contentful. 1 Alternative suppliers
List providers of Customer Relationships Management (CRM) software that could service your organisation’s needs.
List providers of Content Management System (CMS) software that could service your organisation’s needs. The Acquisition

Outline any concerns regarding the effect of the Acquisition on competition, including if Salesforce and Contentful are close competitors and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
